import requests

url = "https://example.com/big.bin"
chunk_size = 8192  # 8KB chunks

with requests.get(url, stream=True) as r:
    r.raise_for_status()
    with open("big.bin", "wb") as f:
        for chunk in r.iter_content(chunk_size=chunk_size):
            if chunk:
                f.write(chunk)
